name: Georgia C.R.E.W. (Cultivating the Rising Experienced Worker) for foster youth
org: Georgia Division of Family and Children Services (DFCS)
what_you_do: Teens in Georgia foster care get career workshops, mentors and coaching. The summer program can include internships or job shadowing with partner employers. You may also get a paid reward for taking part.
who_can_apply: Youth in Georgia foster care ages 14 to 21. The 2026 summer program was for ages 15 to 17 on June 1, 2026 (not turning 18 before July 1, 2026), with a Georgia photo ID and U.S. citizenship, permanent residence or a work card.
pay_detail: Summer participants get a paid incentive for attending weekly sessions. The amount is not stated.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer registration ran March 2 to April 17, 2026. Next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online Georgia C.R.E.W. application on the DFCS site. Everyone, including returning youth, must apply. Call 877-423-4746 (main DFCS number).
notes: Only for youth currently in Georgia foster care. A Career Resource Connection for ages 14 and up and state ID help are also offered. The youth page still showed 2024 dates, so rely on the main page and call to confirm. Ask your caseworker.
